about: Thresholds for the ranking algorithm review. scripts/algorithm_review.py reads this file, so change a rule here and nowhere else. Each key is explained under notes; references/review-checks.md says what each check means.

notes.training_stuck_days: An algorithm still 'In Training' this many days after it was last changed is stuck (trained models usually finish in 24-48 hours).
notes.syncing_stuck_hours: An algorithm still 'Syncing' this many hours after it was last changed is stuck (a weight sync usually takes about 20 minutes).
notes.stale_days: A custom or manual algorithm in use that hasn't changed for this many days is worth a second look: its weights were set for an older catalog and traffic.
notes.dominance_share: One signal with at least this share of an algorithm's total combined weight dominates the ranking.
notes.min_performance_share: An algorithm in use whose shopper-behaviour signals (views, add-to-carts, conversions, revenue) have less than this share of its total weight ignores what shoppers do.
notes.zero_weight: A weight at or below this counts as zero.
notes.custom_signal_share: A custom catalog signal (for example margin or rating) with at least this share of the total weight is driving the ranking; confirm that's intended.
notes.near_duplicate_similarity: Two algorithms of the same scope whose weight vectors have at least this cosine similarity are near-duplicates.
notes.min_visits: An algorithm's served queries or categories need at least this many visits in the sample before its conversion is compared.
notes.underperform_ratio: An algorithm whose sampled queries or categories convert below this share of the others' conversion rate is a candidate for an A/B test against the default.
notes.max_listed: How many signals, scopes or examples to list per finding.
notes.sample_queries: How many top-revenue search queries to fetch a product grid for, to see which algorithm each one uses.
notes.sample_categories: How many top-revenue categories to fetch a product grid for, to see which algorithm each one uses.
notes.max_details: At most this many algorithm details to fetch with search_ranking_algorithms (Error, In Training and custom ones first); the rest are listed as skipped. Read by SKILL.md, not the script.
notes.perf_days: The days window for get_discovery_query_performance and get_discovery_category_performance_table. Read by SKILL.md, not the script.
